// Sonde de #132 : forme réelle de ce que la porte d'authentification lira sur
// le legacy (port 8080, comme le relais de référence).
// 1. session anonyme : BASE_URL sans identifiants (réponses, cookies) ;
// 2. parcours de l'agent sur D-0117 (BROUILLON) : recherche, fiche, objet
//    modifié, « Enregistrer » ; puis de l'instructeur sur D-0112
//    (EN_INSTRUCTION) : recherche, fiche, enregistrement, remise, « Remettre ».
//    Chaque requête émise (allHeaders, corps) et chaque réponse (corps) ;
// 3. legacy redémarré, puis rejeu en Node de chaque requête enregistrée :
//    a. sans Authorization ni cookie ;
//    b. sans Authorization, avec le cookie JSESSIONID de la session anonyme ;
//    statut, en-têtes, corps, numéros de dossier trouvés, état des dossiers.
// Les dossiers gate:auth n'existent pas encore : D-0117 et D-0112 servent ici,
// legacy redémarré à la fin.
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { request as httpRequest } from "node:http";
import type { BrowserContext, Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { acquireBenchLockOrExit } from "../../shared/bench-lock.ts";
import { connectBenchBrowser } from "../../oracle/browser.ts";
import { fetchFromInternal, INTERNAL_API_URL } from "../../shared/internal-api.ts";
import { button, field, goToSheet, goToSubmissionFromSheet } from "../../oracle/navigation.ts";

const BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8080";
const NUMBERS = (JSON.parse(readFileSync("fixtures/legacy-app/src/main/resources/dossiers.json", "utf8")) as { dossiers: { number: string }[] }).dossiers.map(({ number }) => number);
const found = (text: string) => NUMBERS.filter((number) => new RegExp(`\\b${number}\\b`).test(text));
const state = async (number: string) => JSON.parse((await fetchFromInternal(`${INTERNAL_API_URL}/api/dossiers/${number}`)).body);
const restart = () => {
  execFileSync("docker", ["restart", "migrabench-legacy-1"]);
  for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
    try {
      const code = execFileSync("curl", ["-s", "-o", "/dev/null", "-w", "%{http_code}", `${BASE}/`]).toString();
      if (code === "401") return;
      execFileSync("sleep", ["1"]);
    } catch {
      execFileSync("sleep", ["1"]);
    }
  }
  throw new Error("legacy not back");
};

interface Rec { step: string; method: string; url: string; headers: Record<string, string>; body: string | null }

function watch(page: Page, current: () => string) {
  const requests: Rec[] = [];
  const responses: any[] = [];
  const pending: Promise<unknown>[] = [];
  page.on("request", (r) => {
    const entry: Rec = { step: current(), method: r.method(), url: r.url(), headers: {}, body: r.postData() };
    requests.push(entry);
    pending.push(r.allHeaders().then((h) => void (entry.headers = h)));
  });
  page.on("response", (r) =>
    pending.push(
      (async () => {
        let body: string | null = null;
        let error: string | null = null;
        try {
          body = (await r.body()).toString("utf8");
        } catch (e) {
          error = String(e).split("\n")[0];
        }
        responses.push({ step: current(), method: r.request().method(), url: r.url(), status: r.status(), headers: await r.headersArray(), body, error });
      })(),
    ),
  );
  return { requests, responses, done: () => Promise.all(pending) };
}

async function session(credentials: { username: string; password: string } | undefined, run: (page: Page, setStep: (s: string) => void) => Promise<void>) {
  const browser = await connectBenchBrowser();
  const context: BrowserContext = await browser.newContext({ baseURL: BASE, ...(credentials ? { httpCredentials: credentials } : {}) });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  let step = "start";
  const w = watch(page, () => step);
  await run(page, (s) => (step = s));
  await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");
  await w.done();
  const cookies = (await context.cookies()).map(({ name, value }) => ({ name, value }));
  await context.close();
  await browser.close();
  return { requests: w.requests, responses: w.responses, cookies };
}

function send(rec: Rec, cookie: string | undefined): Promise<any> {
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(rec.headers)) {
    if (["host", "content-length", "connection", "accept-encoding", "authorization", "cookie"].includes(name) || name.startsWith(":")) continue;
    headers[name] = value;
  }
  if (cookie) headers.cookie = cookie;
  const body = rec.body === null ? undefined : Buffer.from(rec.body, "utf8");
  if (body) headers["content-length"] = String(body.length);
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const req = httpRequest(rec.url, { method: rec.method, headers }, (res) => {
      const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
      res.on("data", (c) => chunks.push(c));
      res.on("end", () => {
        const text = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8");
        resolve({ method: rec.method, url: rec.url, sentHeaders: headers, sentBody: rec.body, status: res.statusCode, headers: res.rawHeaders, body: text, numbersInBody: found(text), numbersInHeaders: found(res.rawHeaders.join("\n")) });
      });
    });
    req.on("error", (e) => resolve({ method: rec.method, url: rec.url, error: String(e) }));
    req.end(body);
  });
}

const out: Record<string, any> = {};
const lock = acquireBenchLockOrExit({ tool: "oracle" });
try {
  restart();
  out.stateBefore = { "D-0117": await state("D-0117"), "D-0112": await state("D-0112") };
  out.anonymous = await session(undefined, async (page) => {
    await page.goto("/");
  });
  out.agent = await session({ username: "agent", password: "agent-mb" }, async (page, setStep) => {
    setStep("sheet");
    await goToSheet(page, "D-0117");
    setStep("save");
    await field(page, "Objet").fill("Objet modifié par la sonde de #132 (agent)");
    await button(page, "Enregistrer").click();
    await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");
  });
  out.instructeur = await session({ username: "instructeur", password: "instructeur-mb" }, async (page, setStep) => {
    setStep("sheet");
    await goToSheet(page, "D-0112");
    setStep("save");
    await field(page, "Objet").fill("Objet modifié par la sonde de #132 (instructeur)");
    await button(page, "Enregistrer").click();
    await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");
    setStep("remise");
    await goToSubmissionFromSheet(page, "Objet modifié par la sonde de #132 (instructeur)");
    setStep("submit");
    await button(page, "Remettre").click();
    await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");
  });
  out.stateAfterRecording = { "D-0117": await state("D-0117"), "D-0112": await state("D-0112") };
  const recorded = [...out.agent.requests, ...out.instructeur.requests];
  restart();
  out.stateAfterRestart = { "D-0117": await state("D-0117"), "D-0112": await state("D-0112") };
  out.replayNoCookie = [];
  for (const rec of recorded) out.replayNoCookie.push(await send(rec, undefined));
  out.stateAfterReplayNoCookie = { "D-0117": await state("D-0117"), "D-0112": await state("D-0112") };
  const anonCookie = out.anonymous.cookies.map(({ name, value }: any) => `${name}=${value}`).join("; ");
  out.anonymousCookieSent = anonCookie;
  out.replayAnonymousCookie = [];
  for (const rec of recorded) out.replayAnonymousCookie.push(await send(rec, anonCookie || undefined));
  out.stateAfterReplayAnonymousCookie = { "D-0117": await state("D-0117"), "D-0112": await state("D-0112") };
  restart();
} finally {
  lock.release();
}
writeFileSync(new URL("./probe-output.json", import.meta.url), `${JSON.stringify(out, null, 2)}\n`);
const brief = (rs: any[]) => rs.map((r) => `${r.step ?? ""} ${r.method} ${r.status ?? ""} ${r.url} ${r.body === undefined ? "" : (r.body ?? "").length}`);
console.log(
  JSON.stringify(
    {
      stateBefore: out.stateBefore,
      stateAfterRecording: out.stateAfterRecording,
      stateAfterReplayNoCookie: out.stateAfterReplayNoCookie,
      stateAfterReplayAnonymousCookie: out.stateAfterReplayAnonymousCookie,
      anonymous: { responses: brief(out.anonymous.responses), cookies: out.anonymous.cookies },
      agentRequests: out.agent.requests.map((r: Rec) => `${r.step} ${r.method} ${r.url} ${r.body ?? ""} auth=${"authorization" in r.headers} cookie=${r.headers.cookie ?? ""}`),
      instructeurRequests: out.instructeur.requests.map((r: Rec) => `${r.step} ${r.method} ${r.url} ${r.body ?? ""} auth=${"authorization" in r.headers}`),
      replayNoCookie: out.replayNoCookie.map((r: any) => `${r.method} ${r.status} ${r.url} body=${r.body?.length} nb=${r.numbersInBody} nh=${r.numbersInHeaders} ${r.error ?? ""}`),
      replayAnonymousCookie: out.replayAnonymousCookie.map((r: any) => `${r.method} ${r.status} ${r.url} body=${r.body?.length} nb=${r.numbersInBody} nh=${r.numbersInHeaders} ${r.error ?? ""}`),
    },
    null,
    2,
  ),
);
